resolution.note: worker-scope hook, K as lane worker, full-history clones

title: Workers cannot write tracker, roadmap or harness files outside Scope and D23 arm K runs as a worker
body:
Why: D23 diagnosis: arm K ran as the lead, read krn-retro/krn-lead/krn-handoff each run, edited skills/AGENTS.md out of scope in 7/20 units, tasks/*.json in 4 (488 regressed), roadmap in 2, timed out once (487.K), and produced 507 hook messages vs 44 for the plain arm. KRN-11 says workers do not mutate tracker state but nothing enforces it.
Outcome: a worker session (lane) is denied writes to tasks/, docs/program/roadmap.md, .agents/, .claude/ and AGENTS.md by a PreToolUse hook unless the brief's Scope names them; the D23 K arm runs as a lane worker with the `krn lane brief` prompt built by the HARNESS_REF krn against the clone, and both arms' clones carry the full history up to the parent (no later refs).
Proof: a hook test denies a worker edit to tasks/x.json and allows it when Scope names tasks/; a replay test with a fake claude asserts the K prompt is the lane brief and the clone has no commit after the parent.
Scope: scripts/claude/, .claude/settings.json, evals/d23/, test/claude/, test/evals/.
